task.title: To set a style for a segment in a template

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce).
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab, click the More icon () and select Segment.
Highlight a block of text in your template and click Set Style. This opens the Select Styles window that lists custom styles.
Select a custom style or select the Show template styles checkbox and select a style.

postreq.p: The segment is added as Segment Regular to the segments list in the Set Segment pane. Selecting the segment name from the list highlights that segment in the template document.
